implementation_summary: Root causes: 7 default vitest workers each starting Chromium on a 4C/8T 16 GB laptop with 0.7-3 GB free; OneDrive sync using about 2-2.5 logical cores and holding files tests wrote into .tmp-* in the repo; fixed-port clashes; run-slot knock-ons; budgets sized for CI. Changes: worker limit in vitest.config.ts (3 here and on CI); unique OS-temp scratch folders per run in 16 files; credentials-crawl and saved-session-secrecy moved to free ports; failure-only afterEach run guard in 6 runner files; raised timeouts and waits with reason comments; wizard-e2e role-based locator. No assertion weakened, nothing skipped or deleted. Still failing alone: spider-links-and-traps (maxDuration bound 9026 ms against 8000) and auth-crawl-run (signed-in run over 600 s). No full-suite run after the changes.
